svg.title: Morris O(1)-Space Traversal, AVL Rotations, and Red-Black Tree Fixup
svg.desc: Animated visualization of Morris in-order threading on a 7-node BST using O(1) space, AVL Left-Right (LR) double rotation restoring balance factors to {-1,0,+1}, and Red-Black tree insertion fixup contrasting recoloring against rotation to preserve black-height.
svg.text: Morris O(1) Traversal, AVL Rotations & Red-Black Tree Fixup
Threaded Predecessor Links vs Balance-Factor Rotations (h < 1.44 log n) vs Black-Height Fixup (h <= 2 log(n+1))

g.text: Encodes return path back to 4 inside leaf 3's null right pointer.
Every tree edge is traversed <= 3 times (create, descend, clear thread).
1 has no left child, so visit 1 and jump via thread back to 2!
Restores left child pointer; moves right to 3, visits 3, jumps to 4.
Original tree topology is incrementally restored as threads expire.
Step 4: Clear 3.right = null, visit 4, then right subtree
Tree 100% restored to original unmodified pointers!
Complete in-order output in O(n) time and O(1) space.
Inserted node 20 sits in left-right zig-zag. A single right rotation fails!
Fix Step 1: Left-Rotate(10) to straighten into Left-Left (LL).
4 Cases: LL (Right), RR (Left), LR (Left then Right), RL (Right then Left).
Left rotation on 10 lifted 20 above 10, creating a straight left spine.
Fix Step 2: Right-Rotate(30) promotes 20 as balanced subtree root.
Subtrees alpha, beta, gamma preserve strict BST in-order: 10 < 20 < 30.
Phase 3 (Complete): Height Restored in O(1) Pointer Rewiring
Balance factors are all 0. Strict AVL bound h < 1.44 log2(n+2) holds.
Trade-off vs RB: faster O(log n) lookups, slightly more rotations on delete.
LeftRotation(X) <=> RightRotation(Y) with middle subtree beta moving X.right <-> Y.left

svg.text: Order: a < X < b < Y < g
3. Red-Black Tree Insertion Fixup (Preserving Black-Height bh(x) with <= 2 Rotations)
No two consecutive Reds · Root & NIL Black
Case 1: Red Uncle (U) -> Recolor P, U = Black; G = Red

g.text: Before: P and N are both Red.
Uncle U is also Red -> 0 rotations needed!
Push black down from G to P & U.
After Recolor: P, U = Black; G = Red
Black-height of every path through G is identical.
Continue fixup upward at G (root stays Black).

svg.text: Case 2/3: Black Uncle (U) -> Rotate G (+ Recolor P = Black, G = Red)

g.text: Before: Uncle U is Black (or NIL).
P is Black root; N and G are Red children.
